AUTHOR: J. H. Prior; S. Y. Alaba; F. Wallace; M. D. Campbell; C. Shah; M. M. Nabi; P. F. Mickle; R. Moorhead; J. E. Ball
TITLE: Optimizing and Gauging Model Performance with Metrics to Integrate with Existing Video Surveys
REGION: Gulf of Mexico shelf, USA (EGoM and WGoM)
SPECIES: Red Snapper (Lutjanus campechanus) evaluated; SEFSC multi-species model pack
DATA: NOAA GFISHER / SEFSC Reef Fish Video Survey, 2019 and 2021, 1,219 stations
V_EV: Methods/Fig. 3: 'by the relative visibility of the video (overall clarity and ability to see the horizon)'; 'trend towards increased performance at the stations with the least visibility (Vis8 / Vis9)'
D_EV: no statement found (training library described only as '>206.5k individual frame localizations'; relation to test stations not stated)
R_EV: Methods: 'the aforementioned analysis has been repeated using multiple sets of survey videos from the full sampling area in the GoM from multiple years (2019 & 2021)'
C_EV: Results: 'Optimal CTs of performance are consistently between 0.6 and 0.8 range as tradeoffs occur (Fig. 4) between maximum agreement and minimum false positives.'
E_EV: Discussion/Fig. 5: 'The linear regression is calculated as y=1.8x-1.2, (y = manual counts, x = automated counts; R2=0.67).'
ARCH: SEFSC VIAME cascade Faster R-CNN detection/classification with track-level confidence scoring
METR: Percent agreement with manual MaxN, false-positive and false-negative video ratios, CV%, linear regression R2, % within 1-2 fish
NOTE: Training library composition and years not described, so overlap/independence of 2019/2021 test stations from training cannot be judged (D1=NR); R coded N because test videos come from the same GFISHER survey and training years are unstated (if training excluded 2019, year shift could count as external). Visibility is a reader-assigned relative clarity score (Vis3-Vis9) with performance by category (Fig. 3); coded as qualitative (V1=정성 서술만, V6=P) - a verifier could treat the ordinal score as 기타 정량 with quantitative strata -> V_ALL=Y. C5 from per-video false-positive ratio vs manual counts, with CT sweep 0.1-0.95 and optimal CT selection. CODE=Y refers to VIAME open-source models.
